_readme: Fallback + overrides for the Watch tab. Normally /api/videos pulls everything from YouTube automatically. This file is used (1) as the full list when the API key is missing or Google is unreachable, and (2) to override `level`, `pdfUrl`, `pdfEmbedUrl` for a given video id even when the API works. Newest first.
